frozen_before: first Step 3c candidate, holdout run or discovery call
applies_to: agent under test (clean agent and prompt-only mutants) in 3c and 3e
model_deployment_source: agent.MODEL default; FOUNDRY_MODEL env var was not set when frozen
system_sha256_method: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of agent.SYSTEM
tools_sha256_method: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(agent.TOOLS, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
notes: Parameters marked provider-controlled are not sent by the client, so the service default applies; their values are not known to this experiment and are not invented here.
The served model string of each response is recorded per run, because the deployment name does not identify the served version.
